title: Employee Handbook 2026
body_text:
Acme Corp Employee Handbook 2026

1. Working hours: core collaboration hours are 10:00 to 16:00 IST, Monday to Friday.
2. Leave: employees accrue 1.75 days of paid leave per month; requests go to the direct manager.
3. Conduct: treat colleagues and customers with respect and report concerns to Human Resources.
4. Equipment: company laptops use full-disk encryption and automatic screen lock.
5. Expenses: submit claims with receipts within 30 days.

title: Information Security Policy
body_text:
Information Security Policy

Access to customer data is granted on a least-privilege basis and reviewed quarterly.
Credentials are kept in the approved secrets manager and are never shared by email or chat.
Security incidents are reported to Engineering within one hour of discovery.
Production changes require peer review and an approved change request.

title: Customer Support SLA Policy
body_text:
Customer Support SLA Policy

High priority: first response within 2 business hours; resolution target 1 business day.
Medium priority: first response within 8 business hours; resolution target 5 business days.
Customers raising three or more tickets within 14 days are escalated to their account owner.

title: Incident Postmortem - Nightly Data Sync Timeouts
body_text:
Incident postmortem: nightly data sync timeouts

Impact: nightly sync jobs for large accounts timed out, leaving reports stale.
Root cause: a query introduced in the latest release scanned full history instead of the changed window.
Remediation: the query was restored to incremental reads and a runtime alert was added.

title: Customer Onboarding Runbook
body_text:
Customer onboarding runbook

1. Create the customer workspace and invite the named administrators.
2. Import users from the customer's template and assign roles.
3. Configure integrations and run a test sync.
4. Hold the administrator training session.
5. Hand over to Customer Support with the agreed SLA.
